title: Chicken and artichoke bake
summary: Chicken and artichoke bake is a mediterranean dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and canned artichoke hearts, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chicken and artichoke bake into even pieces and toss canned artichoke hearts with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of canned artichoke hearts while you season skinless chicken breast fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken breast fillets and cherry tomatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken and artichoke bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chicken and artichoke bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
